doc.PDDL_domain:
(define (domain ferry)
    (:requirements :strips :typing)
    (:types car location - object)
    (:predicates (at ?c - car ?l - location)  (at-ferry ?l - location)  (empty-ferry) (not-eq ?x ?y)  (on ?c - car))
    (:action board
        :parameters (?car - car ?loc - location)
        :precondition (and (at ?car ?loc) (at-ferry ?loc) (empty-ferry))
        :effect (and (on ?car) (not (at ?car ?loc)) (not (empty-ferry)))
    )
     (:action debark
        :parameters (?car - car ?loc - location)
        :precondition (and (on ?car) (at-ferry ?loc))
        :effect (and (at ?car ?loc) (empty-ferry) (not (on ?car)))
    )
     (:action sail
        :parameters (?from - location ?to - location)
        :precondition (and (not-eq ?from ?to) (at-ferry ?from))
        :effect (and (at-ferry ?to) (not (at-ferry ?from)))
    )
)

  (:requirements :strips :typing) 

  (:types 
    location locatable city - object 
    package movable - locatable

  )		
  
  (:predicates 	
		(at ?obj - locatable ?loc - location)

  :parameters

  :precondition

  (:types 
    location locatable city - object 
    package movable - locatable
    airport - location
    airplane truck - movable    
  )		
  
  (:predicates 	
		(at ?obj - locatable ?loc - location)
		(in ?obj1 - package ?obj2 - movable)
		(in-city ?obj - location ?city - city))


(:action LOAD-TRUCK
  :parameters
   (?obj - package
    ?truck - truck
    ?loc - location)
  :precondition
   (and 
   (at ?truck ?loc) (at ?obj ?loc))
  :effect
   (and (not (at ?obj ?loc)) (in ?obj ?truck)))

(:action LOAD-AIRPLANE
  :parameters
   (?obj - package
    ?airplane - airplane
    ?loc - location)
  :precondition
   (and 
   (at ?obj ?loc) (at ?airplane ?loc))
  :effect
   (and (not (at ?obj ?loc)) (in ?obj ?airplane)))



(:action UNLOAD-TRUCK
  :parameters
   (?obj - package
    ?truck - truck
    ?loc - location)
  :precondition
   (and 
        (at ?truck ?loc) (in ?obj ?truck))
  :effect
   (and (not (in ?obj ?truck)) (at ?obj ?loc)))

(:action UNLOAD-AIRPLANE
  :parameters
   (?obj - package
    ?airplane - airplane
    ?loc - location)
  :precondition
   (and 
        (in ?obj ?airplane) (at ?airplane ?loc))
  :effect
   (and (not (in ?obj ?airplane)) (at ?obj ?loc)))

(:action DRIVE-TRUCK
  :parameters
   (?truck - truck
    ?loc-from - location
    ?loc-to - location
    ?city - city)
  :precondition
   (and 
   (at ?truck ?loc-from)
   (in-city ?loc-from ?city)
   (in-city ?loc-to ?city))
  :effect
   (and (not (at ?truck ?loc-from)) (at ?truck ?loc-to)))

(:action FLY-AIRPLANE
  :parameters
   (?airplane - airplane
    ?loc-from - airport
    ?loc-to - airport)
  :precondition
   (and 
	(at ?airplane ?loc-from))
  :effect
   (and (not (at ?airplane ?loc-from)) (at ?airplane ?loc-to)))
)

(define (domain logistics-strips)
  (:requirements :strips :typing) 

  (:types 
    location locatable city - object 
    package movable - locatable
    airport - location
    airplane truck - movable    
  )		
  
  (:predicates 	
		(at ?obj - locatable ?loc - location)
		(in ?obj1 - package ?obj2 - movable)
		(in-city ?obj - location ?city - city))


(:action LOAD-TRUCK
  :parameters
   (?obj - package
    ?truck - truck
    ?loc - location)
  :precondition
   (and 
   (at ?truck ?loc) (at ?obj ?loc))
  :effect
   (and (not (at ?obj ?loc)) (in ?obj ?truck)))

(:action LOAD-AIRPLANE
  :parameters
   (?obj - package
    ?airplane - airplane
    ?loc - location)
  :precondition
   (and 
   (at ?obj ?loc) (at ?airplane ?loc))
  :effect
   (and (not (at ?obj ?loc)) (in ?obj ?airplane)))



(:action UNLOAD-TRUCK
  :parameters
   (?obj - package
    ?truck - truck
    ?loc - location)
  :precondition
   (and 
        (at ?truck ?loc) (in ?obj ?truck))
  :effect
   (and (not (in ?obj ?truck)) (at ?obj ?loc)))

(:action UNLOAD-AIRPLANE
  :parameters
   (?obj - package
    ?airplane - airplane
    ?loc - location)
  :precondition
   (and 
        (in ?obj ?airplane) (at ?airplane ?loc))
  :effect
   (and (not (in ?obj ?airplane)) (at ?obj ?loc)))

(:action DRIVE-TRUCK
  :parameters
   (?truck - truck
    ?loc-from - location
    ?loc-to - location
    ?city - city)
  :precondition
   (and 
   (at ?truck ?loc-from)
   (in-city ?loc-from ?city)
   (in-city ?loc-to ?city))
  :effect
   (and (not (at ?truck ?loc-from)) (at ?truck ?loc-to)))

(:action FLY-AIRPLANE
  :parameters
   (?airplane - airplane
    ?loc-from - airport
    ?loc-to - airport)
  :precondition
   (and 
	(at ?airplane ?loc-from))
  :effect
   (and (not (at ?airplane ?loc-from)) (at ?airplane ?loc-to)))
)

(define (domain blocksworld-4ops)
    (:requirements :strips)
    (:predicates (clear ?x)  (handempty) (holding ?x)  (on ?x ?y)  (ontable ?x))
    (:action pick-up
        :parameters (?ob)
        :precondition (and (clear ?ob) (ontable ?ob) (handempty))
        :effect (and (holding ?ob) (not (clear ?ob)) (not (ontable ?ob)) (not (handempty)))
    )
     (:action put-down
        :parameters (?ob)
        :precondition (holding ?ob)
        :effect (and (clear ?ob) (handempty) (ontable ?ob) (not (holding ?ob)))
    )
     (:action stack
        :parameters (?ob ?underob)
        :precondition (and (clear ?underob) (holding ?ob))
        :effect (and (handempty) (clear ?ob) (on ?ob ?underob) (not (clear ?underob)) (not (holding ?ob)))
    )
     (:action unstack
        :parameters (?ob ?underob)
        :precondition (and (on ?ob ?underob) (clear ?ob) (handempty))
        :effect (and (holding ?ob) (clear ?underob) (not (on ?ob ?underob)) (not (clear ?ob)) (not (handempty)))
    )
)

(define (domain gripper-strips)
    (:requirements :strips :typing)
    (:types ball gripper robot room - object)
    (:predicates (at ?o - ball ?x - room)  (at-robby ?r - robot ?x - room)  (carry ?r - robot ?o - ball ?g - gripper)  (free ?r - robot ?g - gripper))
    (:action drop
        :parameters (?r - robot ?obj - ball ?room - room ?g - gripper)
        :precondition (and (carry ?r ?obj ?g) (at-robby ?r ?room))
        :effect (and (at ?obj ?room) (free ?r ?g) (not (carry ?r ?obj ?g)))
    )
     (:action move
        :parameters (?r - robot ?from - room ?to - room)
        :precondition (at-robby ?r ?from)
        :effect (and (at-robby ?r ?to) (not (at-robby ?r ?from)))
    )
     (:action pick
        :parameters (?r - robot ?obj - ball ?room - room ?g - gripper)
        :precondition (and (at ?obj ?room) (at-robby ?r ?room) (free ?r ?g))
        :effect (and (carry ?r ?obj ?g) (not (at ?obj ?room)) (not (free ?r ?g)))
    )
)

(define (domain depots)
(:requirements :strips :typing)
(:types place locatable - object
	Depot Distributor - place
        Truck Hoist Surface - locatable
        Pallet Crate - Surface)

(:predicates (at ?x - locatable ?y - place)
             (on ?x - Crate ?y - Surface)
             (in ?x - Crate ?y - Truck)
             (lifting ?x - Hoist ?y - Crate)
             (available ?x - Hoist)
             (clear ?x - Surface))

(:action drive
  :parameters (?x - Truck ?y - place ?z - place)
  :precondition (and (at ?x ?y))
  :effect (and (not (at ?x ?y)) (at ?x ?z)))

(:action lift
  :parameters (?x - Hoist ?y - Crate ?z - Surface ?p - place)
  :precondition (and (at ?x ?p) (available ?x) (at ?y ?p) (on ?y ?z) (clear ?y))
  :effect (and (not (at ?y ?p)) (lifting ?x ?y) (not (clear ?y)) (not (available ?x)) (clear ?z) (not (on ?y ?z))))

(define (domain depots)
(:requirements :strips :typing)
(:types place locatable - object
	Depot Distributor - place
        Truck Hoist Surface - locatable
        Pallet Crate - Surface)

(:predicates (at ?x - locatable ?y - place)
             (on ?x - Crate ?y - Surface)
             (in ?x - Crate ?y - Truck)
             (lifting ?x - Hoist ?y - Crate)
             (available ?x - Hoist)
             (clear ?x - Surface))

(:action drive
  :parameters (?x - Truck ?y - place ?z - place)
  :precondition (and (at ?x ?y))
  :effect (and (not (at ?x ?y)) (at ?x ?z)))

(:action lift
  :parameters (?x - Hoist ?y - Crate ?z - Surface ?p - place)
  :precondition (and (at ?x ?p) (available ?x) (at ?y ?p) (on ?y ?z) (clear ?y))
  :effect (and (not (at ?y ?p)) (lifting ?x ?y) (not (clear ?y)) (not (available ?x)) (clear ?z) (not (on ?y ?z))))

(:action drop
  :parameters (?x - Hoist ?y - Crate ?z - Surface ?p - place)
  :precondition (and (at ?x ?p) (at ?z ?p) (clear ?z) (lifting ?x ?y))
  :effect (and (available ?x) (not (lifting ?x ?y)) (at ?y ?p) (not (clear ?z)) (clear ?y)(on ?y ?z)))

(:action load
  :parameters (?x - Hoist ?y - Crate ?z - Truck ?p - place)
  :precondition (and (at ?x ?p) (at ?z ?p) (lifting ?x ?y))
  :effect (and (not (lifting ?x ?y)) (in ?y ?z) (available ?x)))

(:action unload
  :parameters (?x - Hoist ?y - Crate ?z - Truck ?p - place)
  :precondition (and (at ?x ?p) (at ?z ?p) (available ?x) (in ?y ?z))
  :effect (and (not (in ?y ?z)) (not (available ?x)) (lifting ?x ?y)))
)

(define (domain depots)
(:requirements :strips :typing)
(:types place locatable - object
	Depot Distributor - place
        Truck Hoist Surface - locatable
        Pallet Crate - Surface)

(:predicates (at ?x - locatable ?y - place)
             (on ?x - Crate ?y - Surface)
             (in ?x - Crate ?y - Truck)
             (lifting ?x - Hoist ?y - Crate)
             (available ?x - Hoist)
             (clear ?x - Surface))

(:action drive
  :parameters (?x - Truck ?y - place ?z - place)
  :precondition (and (at ?x ?y))
  :effect (and (not (at ?x ?y)) (at ?x ?z)))

  :parameters (?x - Hoist ?y - Crate ?z - Surface ?p - place)
  :precondition (and (at ?x ?p) (available ?x) (at ?y ?p) (on ?y ?z) (clear ?y))
  :effect (and (not (at ?y ?p)) (lifting ?x ?y) (not (clear ?y)) (not (available ?x)) (clear ?z) (not (on ?y ?z))))

  :precondition (and (at ?x ?p) (at ?z ?p) (clear ?z) (lifting ?x ?y))

  :precondition (and (at ?x ?p) (at ?z ?p) (lifting ?x ?y))
  :effect (and (not (lifting ?x ?y)) (in ?y ?z) (available ?x)))

  :precondition (and (at ?x ?p) (at ?z ?p) (available ?x) (in ?y ?z))

)

(define (domain depots)
(:requirements :strips :typing)
(:types place locatable - object
	Depot Distributor - place
        Truck Hoist Surface - locatable
        Pallet Crate - Surface)

(:predicates (at ?x - locatable ?y - place)
             (on ?x - Crate ?y - Surface)
             (in ?x - Crate ?y - Truck)
             (lifting ?x - Hoist ?y - Crate)
             (available ?x - Hoist)
             (clear ?x - Surface))

(:action drive
  :parameters (?x - Truck ?y - place ?z - place)
  :precondition (and (at ?x ?y))
  :effect (and (not (at ?x ?y)) (at ?x ?z)))

(:action lift
  :parameters (?x - Hoist ?y - Crate ?z - Surface ?p - place)
  :precondition (and (at ?x ?p) (available ?x) (at ?y ?p) (on ?y ?z) (clear ?y))
  :effect (and (not (at ?y ?p)) (lifting ?x ?y) (not (clear ?y)) (not (available ?x)) (clear ?z) (not (on ?y ?z))))

(:action drop
  :parameters (?x - Hoist ?y - Crate ?z - Surface ?p - place)
  :precondition (and (at ?x ?p) (at ?z ?p) (clear ?z) (lifting ?x ?y))
  :effect (and (available ?x) (not (lifting ?x ?y)) (at ?y ?p) (not (clear ?z)) (clear ?y)(on ?y ?z)))

(:action load
  :parameters (?x - Hoist ?y - Crate ?z - Truck ?p - place)
  :precondition (and (at ?x ?p) (at ?z ?p) (lifting ?x ?y))
  :effect (and (not (lifting ?x ?y)) (in ?y ?z) (available ?x)))

(:action unload
  :parameters (?x - Hoist ?y - Crate ?z - Truck ?p - place)
  :precondition (and (at ?x ?p) (at ?z ?p) (available ?x) (in ?y ?z))
  :effect (and (not (in ?y ?z)) (not (available ?x)) (lifting ?x ?y)))
)

    (:requirements :typing)
    (:types agent role - object)
    (:predicates (assigned ?a - agent ?r - role)  (not-eq ?x - object ?y - object))

        :precondition (and (assigned ?a1 ?r1) (assigned ?a2 ?r2) (not-eq ?a1 ?a2) (not-eq ?r1 ?r2))
        :effect (and (not (assigned ?a1 ?r1)) (not (assigned ?a2 ?r2)) (assigned ?a1 ?r2) (assigned ?a2 ?r1))
    )
)

Looking at this swap domain, I need to determine if there's any action that can never become applicable from the current state.

Let me analyze the problem:
- We have 7 agents and 7 items/roles
- Each agent is always assigned exactly one item
- The only action is swapping items between two agents

The key insight is that with swap actions, we can rearrange items among agents in any permutation. Starting from any initial configuration, through a series of swaps, we can reach any possible assignment of the 7 items to the 7 agents.

Let me verify this with the specific action format: (swap ?a1 ?a2 ?r1 ?r2) swaps item ?r1 of agent ?a1 with item ?r2 of agent ?a2.

For an action like (swap dave bob ulluco leek) to be applicable:
- dave must currently have ulluco
- bob must currently have leek

Since we can reach any permutation of items to agents through swaps, we can eventually create a state where dave has ulluco and bob has leek (or any other specific assignment we want).

However, there's one type of action that can NEVER be applicable: an action where the same agent appears twice, such as (swap dave dave ulluco leek). This would require dave to simultaneously hold two different items (ulluco and leek), which violates the constraint that each agent is always assigned a single item.

**Final Answer**: (swap dave dave ulluco leek)

        :effect (isclean ?o)

     (:action close_receptacle
